summary.text: Christy Peterson is the Republican nominee for Colorado's 1st District. She works as an office manager and bookkeeper at a construction company in the Denver Tech Center and is pursuing a doctorate in natural and functional medicine. She says she is running on public safety, lower taxes and limited government.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign biography as reported by the Denver Gazette, she was born and raised in Colorado; her Ballotpedia survey says she is from the Lakewood/Littleton area and she now lives in south Denver.
Graduated from Chatfield Senior High School.
Earned a bachelor's degree from San Diego State University in 2006.
Works as an office manager and bookkeeper for a small construction contractor, according to the Denver Gazette; describes herself as a designer and accountant working in construction.
States she is working on a PhD in natural and functional medicine.

In her Ballotpedia survey she says she decided to become a leader in the Republican Party after events in 2020 and 2025. She was the only Republican to run for the district's nomination and was unopposed.
